# Golden Horse Lifetime Achievement Award

}}
The Golden Horse Lifetime Achievement Award () is an award presented annually at the Golden Horse Awards by the Taipei Golden Horse Film Festival Executive Committee. The latest ceremony was held in 2025, with Chen Shu-fang receiving the honor.
